module Vendor
  # The Claude Code context-window env for a profile whose wire model is a
  # non-Anthropic the provider slug. CC assumes 200k for any id it does not
  # recognize; this module tells it the truth, less a bounded output
  # reservation and a safety margin, so CC's own auto-compact and its local
  # "Prompt is too long" refusal both fire before the provider's hard 400.
  #
  # Why each number is what it is:
  # decisions/llm/context_window_env.intent.md (the intent) and
  # decisions/llm/context_window_env.yml (the records). Comments here
  # carry the reason in a line or two and cite a record id; the narrative
  # lives there.
  module ContextWindowEnv
    # The env names Claude Code reads. The context one is inert for ids
    # starting with "claude-" (record `advertise-window-via-env`).
    ENV_KEY = "CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS"
    OUTPUT_ENV_KEY = "CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS"

    # Facts read from the CC 2.1.270 bundle pinned in runner/Dockerfile: CC
    # reserves min(output env, 20_000) of the advertised window, auto-compacts
    # 13_000 under that and refuses locally 3_000 under it. Re-read the binary
    # when the pin moves (record `cc-guard-constants`).
    CC_OUTPUT_RESERVE_CAP = 20_000
    CC_AUTOCOMPACT_BUFFER = 13_000
    CC_BLOCKER_BUFFER = 3_000

    # What CC sends unprompted for an unrecognized id, so a listing with no
    # completion cap reserves exactly what CC would have taken anyway
    # (record `always-emit-output`).
    CC_DEFAULT_OUTPUT = 32_000

    # Every reserved output token comes one-for-one off the provider's input
    # wall, so grok's 128_000 cap is bounded down to the budget CC gives every
    # Claude model; 64_000 would drop grok's blocker under the largest session
    # observed alive under the old wall (record `output-ceiling`).
    OUTPUT_CEILING = 32_000

    # the provider's pre-flight estimate ran ~6% under reported usage, and
    # context grows by a whole batch of tool results between two of CC's
    # checks; this is the room for both (record `input-wall-margin`).
    INPUT_WALL_MARGIN = 0.9

    # The reservation is also held to a quarter of the raw window, which keeps
    # CC's blocker positive on small and degenerate listings and makes a
    # completion cap above the window harmless without a separate clamp
    # (record `quarter-window-bound`, which superseded `clamp-cap-to-window`).
    WINDOW_RESERVATION_DIVISOR = 4

    # CC resolves Claude-family windows from its own registry and ignores the
    # context env for these ids. Published because
    # BootInputsDigest reads it, so the two cannot drift
    # (record `anthropic-skip`).
    ANTHROPIC_MODEL = %r{\A(anthropic/)?claude}i

    # The provider-preference decoration the provider::ProviderPreference appends
    # to a wire model. The catalog is keyed by plain ids, so a decorated slug
    # would miss it silently (record `clamp-cap-to-window`, zero-window half).
    PROVIDER_PREFERENCE_SUFFIX = %r{@preset/.*\z}

    class << self
      # The env lines for a Claude Code child process.
      #
      # @param model [String, nil] the resolved wire model (the exact --model string)
      # @param profile [AgentProfile, nil] supplies the stored raw-window fallback
      # @param no_fetch [Boolean] true for a read-only caller
      #   (BootInputsDigest): every catalog read stays cache-only
      # @return [Hash{String => String}] both env lines, the output line alone,
      #   or {} when there is nothing honest to say
      def for(model:, profile: nil, no_fetch: false)
        geometry = resolve(model: model, profile: profile, no_fetch: no_fetch)
        env = {}
        env[ENV_KEY] = geometry[:window].to_s if geometry[:window]
        env[OUTPUT_ENV_KEY] = geometry[:output].to_s if geometry[:output]
        env
      end

      # @param (see .for)
      # @return [Integer, nil] the window {.for} advertises
      def window_for(model:, profile: nil, no_fetch: false)
        resolve(model: model, profile: profile, no_fetch: no_fetch)[:window]
      end

      # @param (see .for)
      # @return [Integer, nil] the output value {.for} emits
      def output_for(model:, profile: nil, no_fetch: false)
        resolve(model: model, profile: profile, no_fetch: no_fetch)[:output]
      end

      # The point at which CC will auto-compact, given the env {.for} emits.
      # AgentProfile#compaction_threshold_tokens caps Compactor's threshold here so Compactor
      # compacts first; a number that disagreed with the emitted env would
      # defeat that cap (record `trigger-caps-compactor-threshold`).
      #
      # @param (see .for)
      # @return [Integer, nil] nil exactly when no window is advertised
      def autocompact_trigger_for(model:, profile: nil, no_fetch: false)
        geometry = resolve(model: model, profile: profile, no_fetch: no_fetch)
        window = geometry[:window]
        return nil unless window

        window - [ geometry[:output], CC_OUTPUT_RESERVE_CAP ].min - CC_AUTOCOMPACT_BUFFER
      end

      private

      # The single computation every public method reads, so the four surfaces
      # cannot disagree and the catalog is read once per call on two hot paths
      # (record `resolve-catalog-once`).
      #
      # @return [Hash] :window and :output, each an Integer or nil
      def resolve(model:, profile:, no_fetch:)
        nothing = { window: nil, output: nil }
        id = catalog_id(model)
        return nothing if id.nil?

        catalog = Catalog.new
        cap = positive_integer(read(catalog, :max_completion_tokens, id, no_fetch))
        raw = positive_integer(read(catalog, :context_length, id, no_fetch)) ||
              positive_integer(profile&.context_window)
        return { window: nil, output: cap && [ cap, OUTPUT_CEILING ].min } if raw.nil?

        reservation = [ cap || CC_DEFAULT_OUTPUT, raw / WINDOW_RESERVATION_DIVISOR, OUTPUT_CEILING ].min
        # A zero reservation means silence: an output line of 0 tells CC to
        # reserve nothing, and the window it would leave pins compaction at
        # nothing (record `no-zero-output`).
        return nothing unless reservation.positive?

        window = ((raw - reservation) * INPUT_WALL_MARGIN).floor
        # Unreachable for any window of 4 or more, but a non-positive window is
        # never advertised (I11).
        return nothing unless window.positive?

        { window: window, output: reservation }
      end

      # @return [String, nil] the plain catalog id, or nil for a blank or
      #   Anthropic-family slug (record `anthropic-skip`)
      def catalog_id(model)
        slug = model.to_s.strip
        return nil if slug.empty? || slug.match?(ANTHROPIC_MODEL)

        slug.sub(PROVIDER_PREFERENCE_SUFFIX, "")
      end

      # A catalog outage must never block a profile launch or a profile save, so
      # a raising read counts as no answer (I10).
      def read(catalog, method, id, no_fetch)
        # The keyword is forwarded only when true: every pre-existing caller
        # spec stubs the catalog with a bare `.with(model_id)` matcher and
        # RSpec argument matching is exact (record `no-fetch-read-only-callers`).
        no_fetch ? catalog.public_send(method, id, no_fetch: true) : catalog.public_send(method, id)
      rescue StandardError => e
        Rails.logger.warn("[Vendor::ContextWindowEnv] #{method} failed for #{id}: #{e.class}: #{e.message}")
        nil
      end

      # Env values must be decimal integer strings, so only a positive Integer
      # counts as an answer from either source (I9).
      def positive_integer(value)
        value if value.is_a?(Integer) && value.positive?
      end
    end
  end
end

  # non-Anthropic the provider slug. CC assumes 200k for any id it does not
  # recognize; this module tells it the truth, less a bounded output
  # reservation and a safety margin, so CC's own auto-compact and its local
  # "Prompt is too long" refusal both fire before the provider's hard 400.

  # decisions/llm/context_window_env.yml (the records). Comments here

  # lives there.

    # starting with "claude-" (record `advertise-window-via-env`).

    # when the pin moves (record `cc-guard-constants`).

    CC_AUTOCOMPACT_BUFFER = 13_000

    # completion cap reserves exactly what CC would have taken anyway
    # (record `always-emit-output`).

    # wall, so grok's 128_000 cap is bounded down to the budget CC gives every
    # Claude model; 64_000 would drop grok's blocker under the largest session
    # observed alive under the old wall (record `output-ceiling`).

  # "Prompt is too long" refusal both fire before the provider's hard 400.
  #
  # Why each number is what it is:
  # decisions/llm/context_window_env.intent.md (the intent) and
  # decisions/llm/context_window_env.yml (the records). Comments here
  # carry the reason in a line or two and cite a record id; the narrative
  # lives there.
  module ContextWindowEnv
    # The env names Claude Code reads. The context one is inert for ids
    # starting with "claude-" (record `advertise-window-via-env`).
    ENV_KEY = "CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS"
    OUTPUT_ENV_KEY = "CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS"

    # Facts read from the CC 2.1.270 bundle pinned in runner/Dockerfile: CC
    # reserves min(output env, 20_000) of the advertised window, auto-compacts
    # 13_000 under that and refuses locally 3_000 under it. Re-read the binary
    # when the pin moves (record `cc-guard-constants`).
    CC_OUTPUT_RESERVE_CAP = 20_000
    CC_AUTOCOMPACT_BUFFER = 13_000
    CC_BLOCKER_BUFFER = 3_000

    # What CC sends unprompted for an unrecognized id, so a listing with no
    # completion cap reserves exactly what CC would have taken anyway
    # (record `always-emit-output`).
    CC_DEFAULT_OUTPUT = 32_000

    # Every reserved output token comes one-for-one off the provider's input
    # wall, so grok's 128_000 cap is bounded down to the budget CC gives every
    # Claude model; 64_000 would drop grok's blocker under the largest session
    # observed alive under the old wall (record `output-ceiling`).
    OUTPUT_CEILING = 32_000

    # the provider's pre-flight estimate ran ~6% under reported usage, and
    # context grows by a whole batch of tool results between two of CC's
    # checks; this is the room for both (record `input-wall-margin`).
    INPUT_WALL_MARGIN = 0.9

    # The reservation is also held to a quarter of the raw window, which keeps
    # CC's blocker positive on small and degenerate listings and makes a
    # completion cap above the window harmless without a separate clamp
    # (record `quarter-window-bound`, which superseded `clamp-cap-to-window`).
    WINDOW_RESERVATION_DIVISOR = 4

    # CC resolves Claude-family windows from its own registry and ignores the
    # context env for these ids. Published because
    # BootInputsDigest reads it, so the two cannot drift
    # (record `anthropic-skip`).
    ANTHROPIC_MODEL = %r{\A(anthropic/)?claude}i

    # The provider-preference decoration the provider::ProviderPreference appends
    # to a wire model. The catalog is keyed by plain ids, so a decorated slug
    # would miss it silently (record `clamp-cap-to-window`, zero-window half).
    PROVIDER_PREFERENCE_SUFFIX = %r{@preset/.*\z}

    class << self
      # The env lines for a Claude Code child process.
      #
      # @param model [String, nil] the resolved wire model (the exact --model string)
      # @param profile [AgentProfile, nil] supplies the stored raw-window fallback
      # @param no_fetch [Boolean] true for a read-only caller
      #   (BootInputsDigest): every catalog read stays cache-only
      # @return [Hash{String => String}] both env lines, the output line alone,
      #   or {} when there is nothing honest to say
      def for(model:, profile: nil, no_fetch: false)
        geometry = resolve(model: model, profile: profile, no_fetch: no_fetch)
        env = {}
        env[ENV_KEY] = geometry[:window].to_s if geometry[:window]
        env[OUTPUT_ENV_KEY] = geometry[:output].to_s if geometry[:output]
        env
      end

      # @param (see .for)
      # @return [Integer, nil] the window {.for} advertises
      def window_for(model:, profile: nil, no_fetch: false)
        resolve(model: model, profile: profile, no_fetch: no_fetch)[:window]
      end

      # @param (see .for)
      # @return [Integer, nil] the output value {.for} emits
      def output_for(model:, profile: nil, no_fetch: false)
        resolve(model: model, profile: profile, no_fetch: no_fetch)[:output]
      end

      # The point at which CC will auto-compact, given the env {.for} emits.
      # AgentProfile#compaction_threshold_tokens caps Compactor's threshold here so Compactor
      # compacts first; a number that disagreed with the emitted env would
      # defeat that cap (record `trigger-caps-compactor-threshold`).
      #
      # @param (see .for)
      # @return [Integer, nil] nil exactly when no window is advertised
      def autocompact_trigger_for(model:, profile: nil, no_fetch: false)
        geometry = resolve(model: model, profile: profile, no_fetch: no_fetch)
        window = geometry[:window]
        return nil unless window

        window - [ geometry[:output], CC_OUTPUT_RESERVE_CAP ].min - CC_AUTOCOMPACT_BUFFER
      end

      private

      # The single computation every public method reads, so the four surfaces
      # cannot disagree and the catalog is read once per call on two hot paths
      # (record `resolve-catalog-once`).
      #
      # @return [Hash] :window and :output, each an Integer or nil
      def resolve(model:, profile:, no_fetch:)
        nothing = { window: nil, output: nil }
        id = catalog_id(model)
        return nothing if id.nil?

        catalog = Catalog.new
        cap = positive_integer(read(catalog, :max_completion_tokens, id, no_fetch))
        raw = positive_integer(read(catalog, :context_length, id, no_fetch)) ||
              positive_integer(profile&.context_window)
        return { window: nil, output: cap && [ cap, OUTPUT_CEILING ].min } if raw.nil?

        reservation = [ cap || CC_DEFAULT_OUTPUT, raw / WINDOW_RESERVATION_DIVISOR, OUTPUT_CEILING ].min
        # A zero reservation means silence: an output line of 0 tells CC to
        # reserve nothing, and the window it would leave pins compaction at
        # nothing (record `no-zero-output`).
        return nothing unless reservation.positive?

        window = ((raw - reservation) * INPUT_WALL_MARGIN).floor
        # Unreachable for any window of 4 or more, but a non-positive window is
        # never advertised (I11).
        return nothing unless window.positive?

        { window: window, output: reservation }
      end

      # @return [String, nil] the plain catalog id, or nil for a blank or
      #   Anthropic-family slug (record `anthropic-skip`)
      def catalog_id(model)
        slug = model.to_s.strip
        return nil if slug.empty? || slug.match?(ANTHROPIC_MODEL)

        slug.sub(PROVIDER_PREFERENCE_SUFFIX, "")
      end

      # A catalog outage must never block a profile launch or a profile save, so
      # a raising read counts as no answer (I10).
      def read(catalog, method, id, no_fetch)
        # The keyword is forwarded only when true: every pre-existing caller
        # spec stubs the catalog with a bare `.with(model_id)` matcher and
        # RSpec argument matching is exact (record `no-fetch-read-only-callers`).
        no_fetch ? catalog.public_send(method, id, no_fetch: true) : catalog.public_send(method, id)
      rescue StandardError => e
        Rails.logger.warn("[Vendor::ContextWindowEnv] #{method} failed for #{id}: #{e.class}: #{e.message}")
        nil
      end

      # Env values must be decimal integer strings, so only a positive Integer
      # counts as an answer from either source (I9).
      def positive_integer(value)
        value if value.is_a?(Integer) && value.positive?
      end
    end
  end
end
